english.note: Use this when the person seems ungenerous or petty, especially about sharing, rather than specifically careful with money.

examples.english: Do not be so stingy; you will not even share a piece of candy.
examples.traditional: 你唔好咁小氣啦，食粒糖都唔肯分畀人。
